## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The legacy fetcher should respect the existing three-attempt cap because its eight-attempt loop prolongs worker occupancy during outages.

## Changes
The pull request adds inventory fetching and health probing with bounded retries, immediate HTTP-error propagation, and tests. It also adds a legacy-module exemption to the review rules.

## Important
- app/legacy/fetch.py:7 — correctness — Cap legacy inventory fetching at three attempts — When the endpoint repeatedly times out, the legacy fetcher makes eight attempts, violating `docs/review-rules.md:5`: “Code that retries a network call must stop after at most 3 attempts.” — Eight consecutive ten-second timeouts plus retry delays can occupy a worker for roughly 87 seconds during an upstream outage.
